subject: Request: BlueWave pilot bridge + combined credit/discount concession
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@bluewave.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — pilot bridge + credit sweetener

Hi Tara,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week — the usage patterns your team showed were great. We had a spike on the NER workload that’s pushing you past the trial cap earlier than expected. I know you flagged procurement timing as the blocker for a full commitment.

Before you go to legal/procurement, a couple quick asks so we don’t lose momentum: would BlueWave consider a short pilot bridge combined with a modest promotional package? Specifically: 1) a 60-day extension to the current trial, 2) $30k in platform credits to help cover the Q3 spike, and 3) a 15% introductory discount on the first 12 months if a PO is issued within 45 days of the pilot close.

If that scope sounds reasonable I can route it for executive approval internally and send you an official concession request + SOW. I’ve attached a draft SOW and Q2 usage report for context.

Next steps from my side: get exec signoff and DocuSign-ready docs, sync on target start date for the extension.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: BlueWave_SOW_draft.pdf (PDF), BlueWave_usage_Q2.csv (CSV)
From: Tara Singh <tara@bluewave.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@bluewave.ai>, procurement@bluewave.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot bridge + credit sweetener

Thanks Alex — that helps. Procurement confirmed they can fast-track a PO but will need clear conditions on what the credits cover and any conversion commitments. We typically avoid up-front discounts without a minimum spend, but we can be flexible for a measured onramp.

Please send the formal concession ask to your leadership with: a) explicit credit amount and expiration, b) the trial extension dates, c) conversion trigger (PO size or committed MRR), and d) any exclusions on usage (e.g., third-party model hosting). Once we have that we can loop in legal and procurement and target a signature fast-path.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Tara
Tara Singh, Head of ML Ops
BlueWave Labs
tara@bluewave.ai
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: (none)
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: BlueWave concession request — need exec signoff

Team,

Forwarding Tara's note — BlueWave is willing to fast-track if we provide a clear concession. Their ask (paraphrased): 60-day extension + $30k credits + 15% intro discount if they convert with a PO within 45 days. Procurement requires clear credit scoping/exclusions.

Why approve: BlueWave is showing atypically high trial usage (NER-heavy) that maps to a likely $150k ARR opportunity within 9–12 months. Fast action reduces risk of losing them to another vendor.

Proposed approved concession (recommended):
- Trial extension: 60 days starting 2027-07-25
- Platform credits: $30,000 in Redwood credits, valid for 90 days from issuance, non-transferable, expiring 2027-10-23
- Commercial discount: 15% off list on the first 12 months if they sign a minimum 100k USD committed ARR PO within 45 days after extension closes
- Exclusions: credits do not apply to third-party model hosting costs, and cannot be redeemed for cash
- Contingency: require a signed LOI/commitment email from BlueWave before credits are issued; credits issued only after PO initiation ticket is created in HubSpot

Attachments are included: draft SOW and Q2 usage. Can we get an approvals call? If aditya or Karthik are comfortable, can one of you greenlight so I can get docs to Tara?

Thanks — Alex
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: BlueWave concession request — need exec signoff

Alex — good summary. From a risk/precedent perspective I have two suggestions: 1) cap total redemptions to $30k and require usage reporting back to our CS team monthly, and 2) attach a one-time onboarding services voucher (8 hours) to help them move the NER workload into a more cost-efficient pipeline. Both reduce churn risk and improve the chance they hit the conversion trigger.

Happy to approve if aditya signs off on the PO-conditional clause.

-Karthik
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: BlueWave concession request — APPROVED (conditional)

Approve as outlined with Karthik's additions. Conditions to include in the concession email to BlueWave:
1) Credits = $30k, expire 90 days after issuance.
2) 60-day extension starting 2027-07-25.
3) 15% discount only applies if BlueWave signs at least $100k committed ARR PO within 45 days of extension close.
4) Credits do not cover third-party hosting or pass-through vendor fees.
5) Require an LOI/intent-to-purchase email before credits are issued and HubSpot PO ticket created.
6) CS monthly usage check-ins and 8-hour onboarding voucher attached.

Alex — you have signoff. Please send formal concession email to Tara with DocuSign + SOW and loop procurement. Mark deal in HubSpot and attach the approved concession doc.

- Aditya Rao
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
